students.name: Rakshit G. Hosamani
students.biography: A researcher working at the intersection of environmental science and advanced materials, with a PhD focused on developing catalytic systems for wastewater treatment and dye degradation. My work bridges materials science with forest ecology and plant ecophysiology, including field campaigns measuring photosynthetic thermal tolerance in canopy trees across the Bhadra Tiger Reserve and Goa. Alongside experimental research, I actively engage in biodiversity conservation and community outreach through regional bird and nature walks.

students.name: Pratibha T Bhagawad
students.supervisor: Prof. Yogendra K and Prof. Rakesh Tiwari
students.biography: I am a Research Scholar in the Department of Environmental Science at Kuvempu University specializing in the thermal tolerance of dry deciduous forest tree species in the Western Ghats. Alongside my doctoral research on plant ecophysiological responses to temperature stress, I collaborate with NCBS on long-term forest monitoring initiatives and conduct microclimate sensing and photocatalytic wastewater remediation studies. Holding an M.Sc. from Kuvempu University and a B.Sc. from G.H. College—complemented by industrial experience at Hindustan Aeronautics Limited—my research interests span plant heat tolerance, forest ecology, environmental sensors, and photocatalytic wastewater treatment.
students.research_interests: Plant heat tolerance, forest ecology, environmental sensors, photocatalytic wastewater treatment
